comment: Licence record of the pelorus-dev image (ADR-0179, #256), read by tools/tester/licensing.py. Every file in the image belongs to an Ubuntu package (dpkg ownership; its copyright file is required), to one component below (first match in list order), or to an ignore rule that names a reason and an expiry date. A new tool under /usr/local, a new licence or a new file fails the image build until it is recorded here. Edit this file together with .devcontainer/base/Containerfile; `licensing.py record --record .devcontainer/base/licensing.json` checks it without an image.

notices.title: Pelorus dev container image: third-party notices
intro: Ubuntu packages: each package's licence terms are in /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright. The source
of every package at the installed version is in the Ubuntu archive (apt-get source
The image holds no GPL software built outside a package: git is Ubuntu's own package.
Tools outside the package system are listed under Components with their licence texts.
This file is generated by tools/tester/licensing.py from .devcontainer/base/licensing.json.

ignore.why: files the container runtime mounts or creates, never part of an image layer
package manager and maintainer-script state; the packages it describes are checked by dpkg ownership
configuration and state written by the Ubuntu base image build and by package maintainer scripts, one-line files and generated indexes with no licensable content of their own
configuration of Ubuntu packages (apt, dpkg, pam, systemd units); the scripts are covered by their packages' copyright files
symlinks written by update-alternatives and two-line wrapper scripts written by Ubuntu's container base image build (dpkg diversions of man and initctl)
hash and bundle links generated by update-ca-certificates from the ca-certificates package
bytecode compiled from the Ubuntu python3 packages at install
image metadata written by Canonical's container build (name, version, creation time); no licensable content
the dev container user: a one-line sudoers rule written by the Containerfile and the shell profile files copied from Ubuntu's /etc/skel

components.name: Node.js
notes: The official linux-x64 build, checked against its SHASUMS256.txt entry. Node.js is MIT; its LICENSE file also lists the licences of the third-party code bundled in the binary, and npm and corepack carry their own licence files under lib/node_modules.

components.name: actionlint
notes: The release binary, checked against its published checksum. It is statically linked with Go modules whose licences are in the release's go.mod; the release archive carries LICENSE.txt for actionlint itself.

components.name: Lefthook
notes: The release binary, checked against its published checksum. The release archive holds the binary only, so the licence text comes from the release tag, checked against a pinned hash. The binary is statically linked with Go modules whose licences are in the release's go.mod.

components.name: Pebble service manager (shipped in Ubuntu's container base image)
notes: Part of the ubuntu:26.04 image, outside the package system. Apache-2.0; the text is Ubuntu's /usr/share/common-licenses/Apache-2.0. Not removed because it is part of the pinned base image digest.

components.name: Licence gate of this image
notes: Run `python3 -I -B /usr/local/share/pelorus-dev/licensing.py check --root / --record /usr/local/share/pelorus-dev/licensing.json --commit <40-digit commit>` to repeat the build-time check.

components.name: Licence texts shipped with the image
notes: Verbatim texts from the repository's LICENSES/ directory.
